# Triggers of the Golden Court and the succession. Every Aenor script tests zin_aenor_is_realm (original tag), never a tag.
zin_aenor_council_dominant = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_council_influence value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_council_faltering = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_council_influence value = 35 compare = less_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_court_gilded = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_court_honest = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 30 compare = less_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_date_death_floor = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_golden_king_death option = DELAYED } }
			zin_aenor_date_death_floor_standard = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_golden_king_death option = DELAYED }
			zin_aenor_date_death_floor_delayed = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_aenor_dominion_defiant = {
	check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty < 25 }
}
zin_aenor_dominion_loyal = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_concord_loyalty value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty < 75 }
}
zin_aenor_dominion_restless = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_concord_loyalty value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty < 50 }
}
zin_aenor_dominion_steadfast = {
	check_variable = { var = zin_concord_loyalty value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_eindil_can_be_crowned = {
	has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
	has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named
	has_global_flag = zin_eindil_returned
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost }
	zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
	check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = THIS }
	OR = {
		has_character = zin_eindil
		any_other_country = {
			has_character = zin_eindil
			OR = {
				is_in_faction_with = PREV
				is_faction_leader = yes
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_cast_down }
		has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered
	}
	any_controlled_state = { zin_is_site_parim = yes }
	has_capitulated = no
	NOT = {
		any_enemy_country = {
			meta_trigger = {
				text = { divisions_in_state = { state = [S] size > 0 } }
				S = "[?global.zin_site_parim|0]"
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_historical_path option = HISTORICAL } }
		zin_aenor_date_coronation = yes
	}
}
zin_aenor_eindil_rules = {
	has_country_leader = { character = zin_eindil }
}
zin_aenor_free_dominions_exist = {
	any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_aenor_free_dominion }
}
zin_aenor_hand_known = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_aenor_hidden_hand_seen
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
	}
}
zin_aenor_host_available = {
	has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named
	check_variable = { var = global.zin_eindil_stage value = 8 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}
zin_aenor_is_concord_dominion = {
	is_subject = yes
	NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_aenor_free_dominion }
	has_variable = zin_concord_loyalty
	OVERLORD = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
}
zin_aenor_is_realm = {
	original_tag = Y0L
}
zin_aenor_king_alive = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead }
}
zin_aenor_parim_lost = {
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
			any_controlled_state = { zin_is_site_parim = yes }
		}
	}
}

zin_lost_cause_exists = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_lost_cause_shield
			any_country = {
				zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
				is_faction_leader = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_lost_cause_with_eindil
			any_country = {
				is_faction_leader = yes
				has_character = zin_eindil
			}
		}
	}
}
# zin_aenor_date_death_floor_standard: 1749.5.1 at the standard pace, shifted by zin_story_pace
zin_aenor_date_death_floor_standard = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 }
			date > 1749.11.29
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.875 }
			date > 1749.1.14
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.875 }
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 1.25 }
				}
			}
			date > 1749.4.30
		}
	}
}

zin_aenor_date_death_floor_delayed = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 }
			date > 1755.6.2
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.875 }
			date > 1751.10.16
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.875 }
					check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 1.25 }
				}
			}
			date > 1752.12.31
		}
	}
}
